_doc: Basic kunai throw (no talisman, unlimited). Read by system/jutsu/casters/kunai_caster.gd. Times in seconds, distances in px.

character.note: row 0 wind-up, row 1 the throw (the kunai leaves the hand), row 2 follow-through. The player stands still for the whole motion.

projectile.note: Kunai.png (16x16) points up-right; the sprite is turned by (aim - sprite_points_at_deg). Stops on the first enemy, a wall (layer 1) or at max range.
